I recommend the ZYHKON Wireless Earbuds (Z9Pro) with Touch Screen Case and ANC/ENC Noise Cancelling, in Black (ASIN B0HHDG31LW). They cost $69.99 and are in stock, ship from Amazon (sold by lvshengstore) with free shipping, and come with a 30-day refund/replacement window.

Ratings are reported inconsistently. The listing data shows 4.7 stars, while the page itself shows 4.6 out of 5. Both are based on 94 ratings.

Why they fit:
- They are true wireless in-ear Bluetooth 5.4 earbuds.
- They have Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation, claimed to cut up to 38dB of ambient noise, plus ENC to filter background voices on calls. A Transparency Mode is also included.
- Other features: about 48 hours of total battery with the case, a touchscreen case that controls playback and ANC, 5 EQ modes and IPX7 waterproofing.

Black color: confirmed. Black is the selected variant, and the title says Black. They also come in Blue and Rosa.

Alternatives if you'd like a bigger brand or a lower price:

My pick is "5 Ingredients: Quick & Easy Food" by Jamie Oliver (hardcover, Flatiron Books, 320 pages). It costs $19.29, down from a $39.99 list price. It's in stock and sold by Amazon.com. The listing shows a 4.7 rating, while the page's review summary shows 4.6 stars from 19,954 ratings.

Why it fits:
- **Author:** It's by Jamie Oliver, as you preferred.
- **Quick meals:** It's ranked in Quick & Easy Cooking and pitched as "maximum flavor with minimum fuss" for cooking "any day of the week."
- **Recipe count:** It has 130 brand-new recipes, well above your 50 minimum.
- **Easy:** Every recipe uses just five ingredients.
- **Healthy:** The description promises "lots of nutritious options" across salads, fish, vegetables and more.

One caveat: the book's main focus is simplicity rather than health. It also includes a sweet-treats chapter, so not every recipe is a healthy one.

Alternatives:
- **"Jamie's 15-Minute Meals"** ($27.20, 4.5 stars from 5,314 ratings) is described as "nutritionally balanced." That makes it a stronger health match, but its page doesn't state a recipe count.
- **"Jamie Oliver's Meals in Minutes"** ($25.47, 4.6 stars) offers 50 complete meals in 30 minutes or less. Its page doesn't describe the dishes as healthy, and only 1 copy is left.

- **Same HP model with 512GB SSD and Windows 11 ($949.99):** Cheaper, but it doesn't have the 1TB you want.
- **Dell:** The Dell RTX 3060 listings I found were much more expensive (the XPS 8950 is listed at $8,235.70 and a used Inspiron 3020 at about $3,323). The Dell Inspiron G5 has Windows 10, and the Alienware R10 is out of stock.
